---
"description": "Draft a JSON Schema from sample data and business rules."
"mode": "ask"
"model": "GPT-4"
"file_type": "prompt"
---
Using provided example JSON objects and rules, draft a comprehensive JSON Schema. Include:

1. `$id` and `$schema` declarations.
2. A `title`, `description` and `version`.
3. Definitions of `type`, `properties`, `required` fields and `additionalProperties` (if applicable).
4. Examples illustrating valid data.

Explain any assumptions you make about the data and flag any ambiguities for clarification.
